title: Vogelsdorfer Straße, Neuenhagen
description: Come enjoy a slower pace of life just outside the Berlin borders in the so-called “Speck-Gürtel.” You will love the easy access to green space and the direct connection into Berlin. There is also a bus stop directly in front of the house that can make commuting to Tesla easy. But most of all we think you'll enjoy calling our peaceful oasis home after a busy day of work or exploring.

title: Reiherhorst, Neuenhagen
description:
Discover a home where classic architectural character meets contemporary luxury and intelligent design. Thoughtfully renovated over the past five years, this exceptional residence combines nearly three-metre ceilings, elegant oak parquet flooring, distinctive architectural details and beautifully integrated smart-home technology.

At its heart is a spectacular 41 m2 designer kitchen and dining area, complete with premium Siemens Studioline appliances, a generous cooking island and a Quooker boiling-water tap. The adjoining 48 m2 living room offers an inviting setting for relaxing or entertaining (for example via a movie night on the 100" screen with Bose surround sound), with sophisticated lighting that adapts to your mood at a simple voice command.

Upstairs, retreat to a beautifully appointed master suite with private dressing room and spa-inspired bathroom. An additional bathroom features a private sauna with Himalayan salt wall, while a spacious basement fitness area brings everyday wellness directly into your home.

Outside, a generous terrace and private garden offer room to unwind. A heated double garage with EV charging, extensive storage and ultra-fast fibre internet complete a residence designed to make everyday living effortless. Fully furnished and situated in peaceful Neuenhagen, with convenient connections to Berlin.

title: Heideweg, Vogelsdorf
description:
Willkommen in Ihrem neuen Zuhause in Vogelsdorf! Dieses großzügige und liebevoll eingerichtete Einfamilienhaus bietet die perfekte Kombination aus ruhigem Wohnen im Grünen und einer hervorragenden Anbindung an Berlin.

Das Haus überzeugt durch helle Räume, eine moderne Ausstattung und ein angenehmes Wohnambiente. Der offene Wohn- und Essbereich lädt zum Entspannen ein, während die voll ausgestattete Küche alles bietet, was Sie für den Alltag benötigen. Die komfortablen Schlafzimmer sorgen für erholsame Nächte und ausreichend Stauraum.

Ausstattung:

✅ Voll möbliert und bezugsfertig
✅ Moderne, voll ausgestattete Küche
✅ Privater Garten
✅ Schnelles WLAN
✅ Waschmaschine und Haushaltsgeräte vorhanden
✅ Eigener Stellplatz

*****Die Immobilie wird bevorzugt für einen Zeitraum von 6 bis 18 Monaten vermietet. Bei einem positiven Mietverhältnis und gegenseitiger Zufriedenheit besteht grundsätzlich die Möglichkeit, den Mietvertrag nach individueller Absprache zu verlängern.

title: Fichtestraße, Neuenhagen
description:
Hi everyone!

I'm subletting my room for about six months as I'll be away during this time. It's a really cosy, furnished room with lots of natural light. The window faces east, so the sun shines in throughout the morning and for much of the day. The whole side of the flat, including the room, kitchen and bathroom, gets lovely daylight. It's also a very quiet area, so you can comfortably keep the window open without being disturbed by noise.

The room will stay furnished as you see it in the pictures. I'll just be taking my personal belongings with me and clearing out the wardrobe, shelves and desk so you'll have plenty of space for your own things.

The location might seem a little outside the city centre at first, but it's actually very well connected. The S-Bahn station is just a 7-minute walk away, with a direct connection into the city (around 30 minutes to Friedrichshain and 40 minutes to Hauptbahnhof). There's also a REWE supermarket and a Rossmann drugstore within walking distance. So you get to enjoy a quiet neighbourhood while still having everything you need close by.

You'll be sharing the flat with Paul. He usually works during the week and enjoys spending his free time outdoors, often with his dog or doing sports. We have a relaxed and independent flatshare where everyone has their own routine. We're always happy to have a chat in the kitchen, but there's no pressure to have a particularly social flatshare – you'll have plenty of space and freedom to do your own thing.

Ideally, I'd like to sublet the room from January 1st to June 15th. However, I'm flexible with the dates: moving in as early as mid-December might also be possible, and we can arrange the move-out date in June together.

All bills are already included in the advertised rent, so there are no additional costs. I'd also ask for a security deposit.

If this sounds like a good fit for you, feel free to send me a message and tell me a little about yourself. I'd love to hear from you! :)
